_comment: 示例 spec（SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - not a formal case result）。展示一次文献问答的完整输入：case_id、output_contract、论文字幕（papers，供引文回源核验）、证据池（evidence，含 paragraph_id 与短引文）、按 rubric 形状组织的逐题回答（question_id / answer / conditions / status / claims / unanswered_parts）。所有数据为自拟示意，不是正式案例。

papers.text: P1: Porous TiO2 coatings were deposited by anodization at 20 V for 30 min. P2: The uptake rate of methylene blue increased with the porous coating; the increase was three-fold over the flat control. P3: Samples were held at 25 C throughout the adsorption experiments. P4: Only one coating thickness was tested, which the authors name as a limitation.

answers.question: 多孔涂层对亚甲基蓝吸收速率的影响有多大？
answers.answer: 多孔涂层使亚甲基蓝的吸收速率提高为平板对照组的 3 倍。

claims.text: 多孔涂层使吸收速率提高为对照组的 3 倍

evidence.quote: the increase was three-fold over the flat control

answers.question: 吸收实验在什么温度下进行？
answers.answer: 吸附实验全程在 25 C 下进行。

evidence.quote: Samples were held at 25 C throughout the adsorption experiments.

answers.question: 该研究的局限是什么？作者是否讨论了不同膜厚的影响？
answers.answer: 作者明确说明只测试了一种涂层厚度，这是研究局限；论文未报告不同膜厚的影响，无法确定膜厚是否改变结论。
